summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows , an open source project from GitHub Next, is now generally available. With agentic workflows, you can automate reasoning-based tasks like issue triage, CI failure analysis, documentation updates, and test writing by using coding agents inside GitHub Actions.
takeaways: Ben Alton – Senior manager, Strategy, Architecture & Innovation team at Accenture Built-in safeguards GitHub Agentic Workflows incorporates layered safeguards for your automation.
With agentic workflows, you can automate reasoning-based tasks like issue triage, CI failure analysis, documentation updates, and test writing by using coding agents inside GitHub Actions.
See the GitHub Agentic Workflows release notes for the full list of changes.
